'''Kea Ra-Lan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who operated during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. She owned a [[Kea Ra-Lan's retreat|retreat]] in the [[Dal forests]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]].<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

==Biography==
Ra-Lan was a prolific thief, despite her refusal to fight anybody, including security forces that were attempting to apprehend her. This passivity would often lead her to getting reduced sentences for her crimes. The thief started her career shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. She broke through a blockade around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kassyyyk]] and made her way to [[Kamarkiia]] on the island of [[Wartaki]]. There, she broke into the [[Neocomora|secret vaults of Neocomora]] and stole ancient religious texts that had been thought destroyed. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] ambassador [[Kerrithrarr/Legends|Kerrithrarr]] offered a 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] reward for her capture.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

==Personality and traits==
Ra-Lan was very pacifistic and would not harm living beings or droids.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />
